text:
alex: Quick sync — StratusLabs + EdgeWorks rack-bench smoke check tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: validate perf/W delta after kernel patch and confirm telemetry mapping for marketplace listing. Draft runbook (WIP): https://rwd.in/bench/runbooks/rack-smoke  cc @tanya @raj

tanya: Got it. Target perf/W bump we agreed on? 12–15% across typical throughput envelope?

raj: We scoped 15% median perf/W with <=5% latency regression at tail. I'll validate kernel patch: stratus/kg_patch_v3.2 (prefetch tweak + spin-loop reduction).

maria: Do we have a telemetry schema for exports? Marketplace needs watt-per-req and time-series throughput fields. I need exact field names to wire into listing.

bench-bot: CI triggered: bench/strain/rack-smoke #342 -> https://ci.rwd.in/342 : running quick sweep (seq_len=512, batch=4)

alex: Telemetry fields (please adopt): 'power_w' (instant), 'pdu_power_w' (PDU), 'throughput_rps', 'p50_latency_ms', 'p99_latency_ms', 'kv_cache_hit_rate'. Add derived 'perf_per_w' computed in postproc. Export format: ndjson, filename pattern: rack-smoke-<ts>.ndjson.

jordan: For kernel tuning, pin driver to 0x1f — we saw jitter when hotplug events occur. Command: ```sudo modprobe redmod tune=1f``` Also capture dmesg after warmup.

raj: Will run with prefix cache warmup --warmup 2500. We'll run quant profiles 'q4_1' and 'q8_0' to compare perf/W. Also snapshot kernel symbols: `cat /proc/kallsyms | sha256sum` before/after.

tanya: I'll own the marketplace compliance checklist and copy the telemetry mapping into the listing draft. Also confirm legal OK on publishing any partner logos. If perf/W < 10% improvement we hold announcement.

maria: Stratus confirmed IPMI access for PDUs. Please tag that metric as 'pdu_power_w' and set sampling interval to 1s. We'll align timelines in exporter.

alex: :thumbsup: Schedule recap — smoke run 09:00 PT; rapid analysis & summary by 11:00 PT. @bench-bot if run passes gating thresholds post a short summary to #marketing. If fail, post to #partnerships with failure reasons.

bench-bot: Summary will post to #marketing if run_status == PASS. Current ETA ~1h 10m (running on staging-stratus-3).

raj: Kicking off run on staging-stratus-3 now. I'll add logs to s3 on completion.

maria: I'll stand by to validate telemetry mapping and confirm S3 export path: s3://bench-exports/stratus/rack-smoke/1759993210/

alex: One small ask before we start: capture kernel symbol table sha and the tuned sysctl snapshot: `sysctl -a > /tmp/sysctl.pre` and `cat /proc/kallsyms | sha256sum`

tanya: Copy that. Tagging EdgeWorks contacts for visibility on the run.

alex: Thanks team — keep notes minimal in the runbook (only deviations). We'll iterate on runbook after smoke completes.
